name: Visa / Mastercard Tokenized Card Gateway
author: Alom's English Center
description: PCI-safe tokenized Visa/Mastercard integration interface. Requires an acquiring-bank or payment-service-provider-specific adapter; Visa/Mastercard are card networks, not merchant payment processors. Stripe can accept supported Visa/Mastercard payments through its independent gateway plugin.

settings_schema.label: Card Merchant ID
settings_schema.help: Merchant/acquirer identifier supplied by your bank or PSP adapter.

settings_schema.label: Card Processor API Secret
settings_schema.help: Encrypted server-side credential for the selected acquirer adapter. The generic interface is not live until a compatible adapter is installed.

settings_schema.label: Card Webhook HMAC Secret
settings_schema.help: HMAC secret issued by the selected acquirer adapter.
